records.text: Owens said she learned Erika and Kolvet had a call with Empress Films executive producer Eben Davidson, founder Emma Cooper and two unnamed producers before Kirk’s death; she gave inconsistent August 20/August 28, 2025 dates, so the exact day is unresolved.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: But before you do, another question for you. This time, you and Erika (Erika Kirk), it's regarding August 28th, right, a couple of weeks before Charlie (Charlie Kirk)'s passing. ... Yet curiously, on August 20th, 2025, I learned that Erika (Erika Kirk) had a call with Andrew Kolvet and executives at a company called Empress Films, right? ... Namely, this conference call. was with Eben Davidson, who is the company's executive producer. He came out of a long tenure with Paramount Pictures, and he was running the LA office for Empress Films. ... It was also on the call was two producers, who I'm not going to name. ... plus the founder of Empress Films, which is a woman named Emma Cooper. The company's relatively new, established in 2020. ... And I just would like to know, I'd like to ask, I would like to understand what is the context of this call that Erika (Erika Kirk) and Andrew (Andrew Kolvet) had, what would they have been working on in August of 28th with this company?

records.notes: Owens reports an August 2025 call involving Erika, Kolvet and Empress Films executives Eben Davidson and Emma Cooper, and questions its purpose before Kirk’s death.
